lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all tested change types (adoption redesign, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, home wait_info, and sign_in hint) as each category has only one test so far.
Predictions were generally too high, overestimating positive impact for 4 out of 5 tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Companion Guide Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding step right after home welcome to teach users hotkeys, right-click menus, and hiding options for desktop pets.
candidates.why: Support logs show 3 users were confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding, and finish completion drops to 64.8%.

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Interact With Your Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Right-click your desktop pet to access options, hide them, or open chat mode anytime.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Split View Pet Creation Canvas
candidates.change: Redesigns photo submission into a side-by-side split view showing photo quality tips alongside live preview feedback.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has low conversion (66.2%) and long completion times (mean 1017s), while 3 support tickets complained custom pets failed or looked wrong.

upload_photos.headline: Photo Upload Studio
upload_photos.body: Upload clear, well-lit photos for the cleanest custom pet sprite generation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen into a split view retains its core function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has low conversion (66.2%) and support evidence; redesigns showed +7.1% prior lift but require high implementation effort.

candidates.title: Post-Selection Account Authentication Flow
candidates.change: Moves sign in step after pet selection and photo submission so users create a pet before being asked to register.
candidates.why: Sign in loses 27.1% of users early with a median time of only 3s, showing premature account friction before building commitment.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Diagnostics Verification
candidates.change: Inserts a background verification step after generation to confirm display overlay permissions before launching the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open, causing drop-offs during the home wait phase.

new_display_check.headline: Desktop Display Verification
new_display_check.body: Checking screen permissions and rendering engine setup for your pet.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Pet Render Detailed Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Displays explicit progress status steps and estimated remaining time while generating the desktop pet sprite.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a mean time of 2336s, causing uncertainty over whether generation has frozen or is progressing normally.

waiting.body: Building pet animations and configuring desktop overlay physics...

guard.reason: Showing progress and time estimates for real sprite generation is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step conversion is relatively high (81.3%); previous wait_info test resulted in a -1.0% drop.

candidates.title: Journey Selector Carousel Layout
candidates.change: Presents path options in a full interactive carousel layout focusing on distinct pet personalities and desktop modes.
candidates.why: Choose_path loses 23.8% of users immediately on the first choice of onboarding.

guard.reason: Focusing path options on companion style and desktop modes loses the required choice between adopting and making your own.

candidates.title: Account Pet Restoration Guidance
candidates.change: Adds an advisory message explaining how signing in preserves existing pet data across reinstallations and devices.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the single largest issue category) reported missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your existing account credentials to restore saved pets and settings.

guard.reason: Adding an informative hint about pet restoration on the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by the largest email complaint volume (8 tickets) and easy to implement via copy/config.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Control Callout Copy
candidates.change: Rewrites the final home intro copy to emphasize basic mouse shortcuts for controlling and dismissing the pet.
candidates.why: Finish conversion is 64.8% and multiple users wrote support about not knowing how to control or hide the pet once spawned.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anywhere on your screen to open control options, change behaviors, or hide them.

guard.reason: Updating home intro copy to explain basic mouse shortcuts is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 35.2% of users; addressing control confusion via copy is simple and low cost.

candidates.title: Spotlight Certificate Trait Showcase
candidates.change: Swaps the adoption certificate view to a spotlight layout highlighting pet personality traits and certificate badge.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 66.2% with long completion times.

guard.reason: Replacing the official stamp with a certificate badge fails to maintain the required official stamp on the adoption certificate.

candidates.title: Background Generation Completion Alert
candidates.change: Enables desktop system notifications when generation completes so users can minimize the app while waiting.
candidates.why: Home wait time averages over 38 minutes (2336s mean), leading users to multitask away and abandon the app before completion.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a system alert when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Enabling desktop notifications for waiting completion is an allowed onboarding improvement.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s), but lacks direct support email evidence and needs platform release.

lessons_next: Predictions remain consistently too high, overestimating positive impact across all 9 tests.
sign_in hint changes have shown no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign as its 2 tests do not agree (one won, one had no clear effect).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_screen, home notification, and home wait_info as each has only one test so far.
